verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle inside its cream circle and keeps the pill buttons, but the bottom ~40% of the canvas is empty. The left-aligned headline also sits awkwardly against the right-aligned NEW/Try It stack. B spreads the content better vertically, but the bottle is pulled out of its cream disc, which now floats empty like a broken motif. The pill buttons have turned into plain rectangles, and the NEW badge is now as big as a button, so it competes with the CTA. Its centered buttons also don't line up with the left-aligned headline.
